title: Composable Spot Strategies with Property Tests
instructions: The lesson's design code is provided read-only in `parking/design.py`. In `parking/composite_strategies.py` implement `FallbackSpotStrategy(*strategies)` (first strategy that returns a spot wins; no strategies raises `ValueError`) and `RoutedSpotStrategy(routes, default)` (pick a strategy by `VehicleType`, `default` for unlisted types). Both are `SpotAssignmentStrategy` implementations and must stay read-only: marking a spot occupied is not their job.

evidence.label: On random lots every strategy returns None only when no usable spot exists, otherwise an available spot of the right type on an operational floor, without changing any status
Fallback returns the first strategy's spot and only asks the next one when the earlier ones find nothing
Fallback with no strategies raises ValueError
Fallback returns None when every strategy returns None
Strategy order decides which spot is returned
Routed uses the strategy mapped to the vehicle type
Routed uses the default strategy for unlisted vehicle types
Both composites are SpotAssignmentStrategy instances and can be nested
Floors under maintenance are ignored by the composites
